mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a slowing GDP growth environment (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0%) and concurrent industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% and INDPRO < 100.
